scope: Original 2020 Dune: Imperium base game, standard 2–4-player multiplayer, including required two-player House Hagal procedures. Solo, variants, expansions, promos and Uprising excluded.
summary: Independent source-first challenge found no material answer-key error, edition-scope error, or distinct untested procedure, outcome branch, timing, priority or exception in the supplied authoritative source set. No additions or key fixes proposed.

method.novelty_standard: Accept only a distinct source-defined rule, outcome branch or consequential timing/priority/exception. Reject cosmetic rewrites, card-stat arithmetic substitutions, mechanical combinations of covered rules and unsupported hypothetical branches.

saturation_assessment.conclusion: The reviewed source passages and consequential diagram/card-text branches have question coverage. The recent illustrated-card additions Q71–Q76 were verified directly against the source images rather than accepted from ledger assertions. Further proposed additions in this pass were duplicates, card-stat substitutions, mechanical combinations, nonbinding presentation details, unsupported assumptions or excluded scope.
saturation_assessment.limit: This verdict concerns the supplied original-base rulebook/Board Space Guide/House Hagal pages, applicable official FAQ entries and the specified original publisher card asset; it does not claim to enumerate every possible interaction in an entire physical card collection.
